## Should flag

Where do we find the data? What does the analysis reveal? Which variables matter most? How can we improve efficiency?

*(academic)*

## Should not flag

What is the result? The methodology was sound.

*(academic)*

When can we start? We're ready to begin immediately.

*(journalism)*

Why did you choose this approach? The performance metrics are clear.
